description: Linux VM with SSH key authentication, placed in a subnet.

admin_password.description: (Optional) The password associated with the local administrator account. Required for Windows, and for Linux when disable_password_authentication is false.
admin_password.title: Admin password

admin_ssh_public_key.description: (Optional) The SSH public key used to authenticate to the Virtual Machine. Only used when os_type is Linux.
admin_ssh_public_key.title: SSH Public Key

admin_username.description: (Required) The username of the local administrator used for the Virtual Machine. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
admin_username.title: Admin Username

custom_data.description: (Optional) The Base64-Encoded Custom Data which should be used for this Virtual Machine, such as a cloud-init script.
custom_data.title: Custom data

disable_password_authentication.description: (Optional) Whether password authentication should be disabled on this Linux Virtual Machine.
disable_password_authentication.title: Disable password authentication

identity_ids.description: (Optional) A list of User Assigned Identity IDs to be assigned to this Virtual Machine. Required when identity_type includes UserAssigned.
identity_ids.title: Identity ids

identity_type.description: (Optional) The type of Managed Identity for this Virtual Machine. Possible values are SystemAssigned, UserAssigned and SystemAssigned, UserAssigned. Set to null to disable.
identity_type.title: Identity type

name.description: (Required) The name of the Virtual Machine. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
name.title: VM Name

os_disk_caching.description: (Optional) The Type of Caching which should be used for the OS Disk. Possible values are None, ReadOnly and ReadWrite.
os_disk_caching.title: Os disk caching

os_disk_size_gb.description: (Optional) The Size of the Internal OS Disk in GB, if you wish to vary from the size used in the source image.
os_disk_size_gb.title: OS Disk Size (GB)

os_disk_storage_account_type.description: (Optional) The Type of Storage Account which should back this the Internal OS Disk.
os_disk_storage_account_type.title: Os disk storage account type

os_type.description: (Optional) The operating system family for the Virtual Machine. Possible values are Linux and Windows.
os_type.title: Os type

private_ip_address.description: (Optional) The static private IP address to assign to the network interface. Required when private_ip_address_allocation is Static.
private_ip_address.title: Private ip address

private_ip_address_allocation.description: (Optional) The allocation method used for the private IP address on the network interface. Possible values are Dynamic and Static.
private_ip_address_allocation.title: Private ip address allocation

public_ip_address_id.description: (Optional) The ID of an existing Public IP Address to associate with the network interface.
public_ip_address_id.title: Public ip address id

resource_group_name.description: (Required) The name of the resource group in which to create the Virtual Machine. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.
resource_group_name.title: Resource Group

size.description: (Required) The SKU which should be used for this Virtual Machine, such as Standard_B2s.
size.title: VM Size

source_image_reference.description: (Optional) The source image reference used to create the Virtual Machine.
source_image_reference.title: Source image reference

subnet_id.description: (Required) The ID of the Subnet where the Virtual Machine's network interface should be created.
subnet_id.title: Subnet

tags.description: (Optional) A mapping of tags to assign to the resource.
tags.title: Tags

title: Linux Virtual Machine
